meta.triageRationale: bugfix/small (ISSUE-2f4cb54c): material() rebuilds the whole review material on every call; a CPU profile of the frozen daemon put 57 of 60 s there.

body.focus: Each review adapter builds its material once and every caller reads that same material (src/workflow/review-pipeline/code-review.ts modelDimensionAdapter's material()), so a divided review's cost no longer multiplies by its number of calls. Output identical; no caller, signature or contract changes. Test: the material is built once per adapter however many calls read it, and is the same material as before.
body.summary: modelDimensionAdapter's material() is built on the first read and returned to every later one, instead of rebuilding the whole material per chunk, relation, validation and duplicate-stage call. A test reads it 51 times through a counting spec (coverage and quality): built once, the same object every time, and equal to a fresh adapter's material.
